head: KAE KING Studio turns a 30-second phone vocal into a full song
dek: KAE KING Studio is a new service that takes a short melody you sing or hum into your phone and builds a finished track and music video from it. Making and sharing a song is free; releasing it on Spotify, Boomplay or YouTube means buying the master.
details: The steps: record a 30-second melody, choose a genre and a mood, write lyrics or let the service generate them, then create and share. The listing gives no prices for the master. The makers also offer a residency at a licensed studio in Zanzibar with booth recording and 4K video shoots. It was featured on BetaList on 21 November.
where: Online, out now; free to create and share, paid master for release
means: If you have a tune in your head but no instruments or studio, you can hear a full version of it without paying anything.
todo: Try a song for free first. Check the price of the master before you plan a release on Spotify or YouTube.
thumb_words: HUM A TUNE, GET A FULL SONG
